pipeline: fresh ToxLens retraining on exact published test folds

benchmark_publication.citation: Huang K, Fu T, Gao W, et al. Therapeutics Data Commons: Machine Learning Datasets and Tasks for Drug Discovery and Development. NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks, 2021.

tdc_ames.validation_policy: 90%/10% split of published development only; canonical duplicate molecules grouped; published test untouched

tdc_herg.validation_policy: 90%/10% split of published development only; canonical duplicate molecules grouped; published test untouched

tdc_dili.validation_policy: 90%/10% split of published development only; canonical duplicate molecules grouped; published test untouched

excluded.DeepTox/Tox21 Challenge: Explicitly excluded at the user's request because that benchmark has already been completed.
excluded.MoleculeNet Tox21 recreation: Excluded because the original paper reports random Tox21 splits; the previous scaffold split was not an exact paper reproduction.
excluded.TDC LD50_Zhu: Excluded because it is a regression benchmark and this ToxLens pipeline is classification-only.
